name: nba-prop-command-center
description: Personal NBA prop/parlay/ladder tracker (static PWA). The app itself has no build step and no runtime dependencies; this file only defines the test commands.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.check: node -e "for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync('.').filter(f => f.endsWith('.js'))) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', f], { stdio: 'inherit' })"
